subject: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing, token volumes, $/1M token target
messages:
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice@fintechx.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, david_kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery call recap & next steps — unit economics follow-up

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can run a tight unit-econ deep-dive on our side before our next session: 

What we heard:
- You plan to pilot our embeddings/chat features for two key product flows: customer support summarization and an in-app assistant.
- Expected ramp: ~50M tokens/month in Q1 of pilot, scaling toward ~200M tokens/month over 9–12 months if conversion metrics hit.
- Budget band discussed on call: ~$8k–$12k/month initially (you mentioned potential flexibility for committed volume).
- Security: SOC 2 + SSO required (we have Private/Dedicated options).

Asks / data requests (small list):
1) Please confirm the expected token distribution (rough split between embeddings vs generation and avg tokens per interaction). For example: avg generation = 500 tokens/response, embeddings calls = 2k tokens/record.
2) Target $/1M tokens you're evaluating or comfortable with for pilot vs long-term. You mentioned a target in the low-mid double digits on the call — can you confirm a range?
3) Any internal CAC / payback guardrails we should be aware of (e.g., desired CAC payback = <9 months)?

I've attached our starter unit-econ model (2026-06-18_unit-econ-model.xlsx) that maps token cost to $/feature and margin targets. If you can confirm (1)-(3) above, we'll populate the model with your numbers and share a recommended pricing scenario (hosted vs dedicated) and expected margin impact.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the two bullet items above via reply by EOD Friday.
- We schedule a 45-min unit-econ deep-dive next week where Aditya (SE) will walk through the model and pricing scenarios.

Thanks — and happy to hop on another quick call if it's easier to walk through the asks.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachment: 2026-06-18_unit-econ-model.xlsx (Excel)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the model. Confirming the items you asked for below: 

1) Token distribution (pilot):
- Generation (in-app assistant + summaries): ~85% of usage
- Embeddings (semantic search/recall): ~15%
- Avg tokens per generation call: ~450–550 tokens (we expect 1–2 short generative responses per user action)
- Avg tokens per embedding call: ~1,800 tokens (batching fingerprints)

2) Target $/1M tokens: for pilot our procurement and finance teams prefer a target range of $35–$55 per 1M tokens. That keeps the feature-level cost within our product margin targets. Long-term (if we commit 200M+/mo) we'd look to push to $20–$30 / 1M tokens with reserved capacity.

3) CAC / payback: our current internal goal for these product add-ons is CAC payback <= 9 months; typical target is 6–9 months depending on feature monetization.

Security notes: procurement attached a short doc (FintechX_Security_Reqs.pdf) listing SOC2, SSO, and data residency questions. We'll need answers for those before contracting but that shouldn't block the pilot.

Happy to join next week — Thurs or Fri afternoon PST works for our team.

Thanks,
Alice Zhang
Product Lead — Conversational AI | FintechX
alice@fintechx.com

Subject: RE: Discovery call recap & next steps — unit economics follow-up

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmation, Alice. A couple of follow-ups and initial mapping so the deep-dive is productive: 

Initial mapping to your targets:
- Using your pilot numbers (50M tokens/mo) and your target $35–$55 / 1M tokens, per-feature cost examples:
  - If avg generation = 500 tokens, cost per feature = (500 / 1,000,000) * $35–$55 = $0.0175 – $0.0275 per feature.
  - If embeddings calls average 1,800 tokens, cost per embedding = (1,800 / 1,000,000) * $35–$55 = $0.063 – $0.099 per embedding call.

- For the long-term committed band (200M/mo) at $20–$30 / 1M tokens, those per-feature costs drop ~60–65%.

Quick note on margin / CAC payback:
- If your feature monetizes at $1.00 ARPU per active use and you convert X users to Y recurring sessions, we can show scenarios where the incremental gross margin after inference cost is ~70–80% at pilot pricing, which supports a 6–9 month CAC payback depending on activation. We'll walk through a few concrete scenarios in the deep-dive.

Next steps:
1) I've scheduled a 45-min deep-dive for Thu 2026-06-24 11:00 AM PST (invitation sent — please accept).
2) Aditya, can you prepare two pricing scenarios for the deck:
   - Hosted: pay-as-you-go with volume tiers aligned to $/1M token targets above
   - Dedicated: reserved capacity pricing showing committed 12-month and 36-month bands (with projected $/1M token in the $20–$30 range at 200M+/mo)
3) I'll populate the attached unit-econ model with Alice's numbers and share before the meeting.

If procurement needs earlier responses on SOC2 / SSO questions, David will follow up separately.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Marissa
Attachment: populated_2026-06-18_unit-econ-model.xlsx (Excel)
